div.head: Ine 75
div.ab: CXIX. Gif mon ceap befehð forstolenne, ⁊ seo hond tymð þonne, seo hine mon ætbefehð, to oþrum men, gif se mon hine þonne onfon nylle (þæs ceapes) ⁊ sægð, þæt he him næfre þæt ne sealde, ac sealde oðer, þonne mot se gecyðan se ðe hit tymð to þære honda, þæt he him nan oþer ne sealde buton ðæt ilce.

CXVIIII. Gif mon ceap befehþ forstolenne, ⁊ sio hond tiemð þonne, sio hine mon ætbefehþ, to oþrum men, gif se mon hine þonne onfon ne wille ⁊ sægþ, þæt he him næfre þæt ne sealde, ac sealde oþer, þonne mot se gecyðan, se ðe hit tiemþ to þære honda, þæt he him nan oðer ne sealde buton þæt ilce.

Si captale (quodlibet) intercietur furtiuum, et ille super quem intercietur aduocet inde, si aduocatus nolit hoc recipere et dicat, quod nunquam hoc ei uendidit, sed aliud, tunc licebit aduocanti (appellantem) ipsam manum in uerum mittere, quod nullum aliud uendidit ei quam id ipsum.

{CXVIIII} Gif mon ceap befehþ forstolenne, ⁊ sio hond tiemð þonne sio hine mon ætbefehþ to oþrum men: gif se mon hine þonne onfon ne wille ⁊ sægþ þæt he him næfre þæt ne sealde ac sealde oþer, þonne mot se gecyðan se ðe hit tiemþ to þære honda, þæt he him nan oðer ne sealde buton þæt ilce.

If stolen goods are seized, and then the man [hand] in whose possession the goods were seized vouches a second man to warranty: if the second man will not accept it and says that he never sold him that [property in question] but sold him something else, then he who vouches [him] to warranty must declare, that he sold him none other than that same [property].

If a stolen chattel is attached, and the person in whose possession it is attached vouches it to another man, and if the man will not admit it, and says that he never sold him that, but that he sold him some other thing, he who vouched the man to warranty may declare that he [the witness] sold him none other but that same thing.

If anyone attaches stolen property, and the person with whom it is attached vouches another man to warranty, if that man will not admit it and says he never sold it to him, but sold him something else, then he who is vouching that person to warranty may declare that he sold him nothing other than that same thing.

Wenn gestohlenes Gut im Anefang gefasst wird, und die Person, bei der es gefasst wird, zieht nun die Gewähr auf einen andern Mann: wenn dieser Mann jenes [Zugeschobene] dann nicht annehmen will und sagt, dass er ihm dieses nie verkauft habe, vielmehr [etwas] anderes verkauft habe, dann darf, wer es zu dieser Person [in Gewähr] zieht, [durch Eid] beweisen, dass er [der herangezogene Gewährsmann] ihm kein anderes als dieses selbe verkauft hat.

If stolen goods are seized by attachment, and the person from whom they are seized now vouches to warranty upon another man: if that man will not accept that [which is vouched to him] and says that he never sold him this, but sold him something else, then whoever vouches it to that person [as warrantor] may prove [by oath] that he [the warrantor called upon] sold him nothing other than this very thing.
